text:
sarah_k: Heads up — during the quant4b bringup we saw padding tokens scattered in synthetic anchors. That produced multiple near-duplicate samples that slipped into the golden refresh. Need quick triage before we push the rollout.

omar_r: Can you drop an example? Is this tokenizer or sampling noise?

sarah_k: here's two short examples (redacted):
```
<pad> Hello, how can I help you today? <pad> what's the weather...
```
```
Hello, can you tell me the time? <pad> <pad> Please respond.
```
They look like padding mid-prompt, not just trailing pads. Frequency spikes in the synthetic anchor cohort.

jules_p: That'll mess up dedupe heuristics. Our fingerprinting assumes contiguous padding at end. :eyes:

curation-bot: Automated dedupe scan ran: 84 collisions across 'synthetic-anchors-v2' and 'golden-refresh-2026-03'.

labelops_bot: Temporarily pausing golden assignment for cohort 'synthetic-anchors-v2' (queue mute by labeler group) — until triage complete.

carmen: I'll hold labeler slots. @noah_qa can you run tokenizer sanity on the model binary? Quick check: tokenization boundaries + pad id mapping.

noah_qa: On it — queuing a small sanity run now. Will post outputs in ~20m.

omar_r: If it's sampling noise we can add a post-filter that rejects samples with interior pad tokens or high pad density. But that feels hacky for longterm.

sarah_k: Agreed. Short term: post-filter + pause labeler assignments. Medium term: determine whether it's generation-time tokenization mismatch or a model bug after quantization.

jules_p: Also recommend re-running dedupe with a token-aware sliding window rather than fingerprinting whole prompt — that'll catch interior pads. I'll prototype.

curation-bot: Action items recorded: [pause golden assignments], [post-filter prototype], [tokenizer sanity run], [dedupe sliding-window POC].

labelops_bot: Labelers notified — teams A/B will get redirected to fallback cohorts. :white_check_mark:

sarah_k: Thanks all. @omar_r @jules_p pls sync on POC today. @carmen I'll tell labelers to stand down until we confirm. We'll reconvene after noah_qa's run.

noah_qa: Posting tokenizer sanity results: detected two mappings where pad id appears in middle of encoded sequences for ~0.7% of samples. Attaching snippet in the thread (redacted). Suggest we hold the rollout.

omar_r: ok hold. I'll start a small repro with quantized binary + reference tokenizer to isolate root cause.

jules_p: I'll push prototype dedupe into experiment branch and run on the 84 collision set. ETA 3h.

sarah_k: Perfect. We'll block golden refresh merge until we have a remediation. Thanks everyone. :pray:
